subject: Enterprise access governance — handoff & implementation checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@meridianbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Enterprise access governance — handoff & implementation checklist

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. As discussed, I’m starting the formal handoff from Sales to our Implementation / Success teams so we can lock down the access control items required for your production rollout. I’m attaching a concise checklist (XLSX) that we’ll use to track requirements and signoffs. Core items we need to confirm from Meridian before we schedule the implementation window: 

1) SSO/SAML
   - IdP metadata (entityID, SSO URL, x509 cert)
   - Desired NameID format (email / persistent) and attribute mapping (email, given_name, last_name, groups)
   - SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated preference

2) SCIM provisioning
   - SCIM base URL and service account credentials (Bearer token)
   - Attribute set for provisioning/deprovisioning and group sync cadence

3) IP allowlists / egress rules
   - Source IP CIDR ranges to allow for provisioning and health checks
   - Any proxy / NAT jumps we need to be aware of

4) Service accounts & delegated access
   - Names and purpose for service accounts that will call Redwood APIs
   - Rotation policy and recommended TTLs

5) Org policies & auditing
   - Required MFA enforcement, password rotation windows, session timeout policies
   - Audit log retention period and log export destination (if required for your SOC / audit team)

6) Test plan & staging access
   - Test user list, test groups, and acceptance criteria for signoff

Please review the attached checklist and reply with the metadata and IP list where available. If you prefer, we can capture credentials via our secure DocuSign/KM link — let me know.

Next steps I propose after we get the details: schedule a 60-minute implementation slot (we’ll include Monica and Laura to drive the SCIM and SSO work), run a provisioning smoke test, and then schedule a short signoff window with your security team.

Attachments: Redwood_Access_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,

Thanks Karthik — this is great and aligns with what our security team wanted to see. A few quick notes from my side: 

- I’ve asked our IdP team to export the metadata; we should have the SAML XML by end of day tomorrow.
- SCIM: we use an internal service account pattern (scim-provisioner@meridianbank.com). We cannot send credentials over email; we’ll use the secure upload link.

2) What are the default token TTL and recommended rotation cadence for service account tokens?

If you and Monica can confirm the answers, I’ll book the kickoff for next Wednesday afternoon.

Regards,

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Enterprise access governance — handoff & implementation checklist

Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the CIDR list. Short answers to your questions: 

1) SCIM delta sync: yes — Redwood supports delta provisioning using SCIM 2.0 PATCH semantics. In practice we do a nightly full sync by default and can enable near-real-time delta sync for groups if you need lower latency. We can make the frequency configurable on your Dedicated tenant.

2) Service account token TTL: default is 90 days. We recommend rotation every 60 days for high-security orgs. We also support short-lived tokens via our KMS integration if you prefer not to store long-lived tokens.

Implementation notes and assumptions:
- We will use SP-initiated SAML by default unless you confirm otherwise.
- Attribute mapping: we'll map email -> userName, given_name, family_name, and groups -> groups.membership with a single-valued group namespace. If Meridian needs custom attributes (employee_id, cost_center), add them to the spreadsheet before the kickoff.
- IP allowlist: we will add your CIDRs to our partner ACL for provisioning and to the health-check whitelist. If you have egress from multiple NAT/SP locations, please mark which are production vs. staging.

Proposed schedule: 
- Fri 19 Jun 2026: secure upload of IdP metadata and SCIM token (Alice)
- Wed 24 Jun 2026, 1:30–2:30pm PT: Implementation kickoff (Monica, Laura, Karthik, Meridian IdP & Ops)
- Thu 25 Jun 2026: SCIM smoke test + SAML assertion test (staging)
- Mon 29 Jun 2026: Production cutover window (subject to signoff)

I’ll create the calendar invite if that timeline works. Also linking the internal runbook we’ll follow: https://redwood-internal.app/roadmaps/MERID-4721

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

— Monica
